EditorConfig Generator

Build an .editorconfig file — indentation, line endings, charset and per-language overrides.

📖 How to use

  1. Set root, charset, indent style and line endings.
  2. Toggle trailing-whitespace and final-newline rules.
  3. Add an optional per-file-pattern section.
  4. Copy the config or download .editorconfig.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is EditorConfig?

A standard that keeps coding styles consistent across editors — most editors read .editorconfig automatically.

What does "root = true" do?

Stops EditorConfig from looking for .editorconfig files in parent directories.

How do per-pattern sections work?

Sections like [*.{js,ts}] override the global rules for matching files.

Where does the file go?

Save as .editorconfig in your project root.
